title: Prevent intervening tasks from contaminating authority and evidence
narrative: Task-local evidence, policy, memory references, and approvals must not bleed across intervening tasks unless an explicit typed handoff shares them. Related contracts: `fangore_insp_isolation_io`, `fangore_insp_handoff_record`. Tracks MH-DOTS-07[^insp-dots-07].
implementation: IsolationContract, workspace isolation, HandoffRecord, CapabilityEnvelope. Desired: hard multi-task runtime boundary with five- and ten-intervening-task bleed tests.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-DOTS-07, coverage partial, adjacent_ok true.
